cards.card_text: The older sister is named Oholah, and her sister is named Oholibah.
cards.verse_text: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.
cards.snippet: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.

cards.card_text: Oholah stands for Samaria, the city where the kings of the northern kingdom of Israel reigned (1 Kings 16:29).
cards.verse_text: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.
cards.snippet: The older was named Oholah, and her sister was named Oholibah.

cards.verse_text: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine.
cards.snippet: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine.

cards.card_text: Oholah chased other lovers while she still belonged to God.
cards.verse_text: Oholah prostituted herself while she was still Mine.

cards.card_text: Who are these warriors in blue that Oholah chases?

cards.card_text: God has been picturing Samaria and Jerusalem as two sisters, Oholah and Oholibah, who became His but were unfaithful to Him (Ezekiel 23:4-5, 11).
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?
cards.snippet: …LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?

cards.card_text: God tells Ezekiel to declare to Oholah and Oholibah their abominations.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD said to me: “Son of man, will you pass judgment against Oholah and Oholibah?

cards.card_text: And the men slept with Oholah and Oholibah as with a prostitute.
cards.verse_text: And they slept with her as with a prostitute; they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those lewd women.
